name: Lost Contact
description: Enemies that lose sight of you for a few seconds stop knowing where you are: they search where they last saw you instead of tracking you across the map. Patrols walk between their own outposts instead of being sent straight at you; one that finds you fights as usual. Each on, observe (counts in the log only) or off: lost-contact.ini, or Ctrl+F9 / Ctrl+F10 in a mission. A character kit can limit them while it acts (Lemuen: patrols only). Host or solo.
